commands:
cat > .git/hooks/pre-commit << 'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
# Pre-commit hook to run mypy type checking on all Python files in src/

echo "Running mypy type checking on src/..."
mypy src/

if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then
    echo "❌ Type checking failed! Commit blocked."
    exit 1
fi

echo "✅ Type checking passed!"
EOF
test -f .git/hooks/pre-commit && echo "Pre-commit hook exists" || echo "Pre-commit hook missing"
